description: This file defines the 'LocalizedConverter' interface in Java, establishing methods for converting objects with localization and timezone considerations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: LocalizedConverter
classes.description: An interface for localized object conversions, extending the 'Converter' interface and providing methods that include locale and timezone parameters.
